body: ONE PROTOCOL CORRECTION to the general lesson: candidate v1 reviewer sets are **all-of**, not fallback/any-of. The accepted protocol says every required reviewer must currently approve; one missing reviewer blocks. Therefore naming two does not protect against a session ending—it doubles the approval requirement and still requires a successor if either disappears. The safe lesson is: name the intended active independent reviewer, ensure they accept promptly, and expect a same-commit successor when immutable staffing changes. Threshold/any-of policies are explicitly deferred. The concrete Root -> collab successor command remains correct.
